rules.missing_hash: Do not treat as verified or ready to publish. Obtain a pinned source and hash during release assembly.
rules.relative_urls: Resolve against app entry URL unless an alias note states otherwise.
rules.query_matching: Explicit request aliases preserve sha256 query parameters. Any generalized normalization must verify expected hash.
rules.example_assets: Examples are separate from mandatory scientific assets. Include when the offline app exposes the example action.
rules.total_bytes: No total is claimed; aliases, examples and shared assets must be reconciled first.
rules.npm_urls: npm: entries name locally installed runtime files selected by source staging scripts. They are not HTTP download URLs; resolve through the pinned package and preserve staging paths.
